Package chess.service

Interface GameListener

All Known Implementing Classes:
GameController, GameLogger
public interface GameListener
Something that wants to be told when the game changes: the GUI panels, the logger and so on. This is the Observer pattern.

Game keeps a list of listeners and calls these methods after each change, without knowing what the listeners are. That lets the back end stay independent of Swing: the GUI redraws itself when told to, and the game never calls GUI code directly.

Every method has an empty default, so a listener only overrides the events it cares about.
